title: Bach Ma, one trail
summary: Report before 09:00, walk the road the gate is actually using, and add one trail. Be back at the visitor center before 17:00. A summit night is a separate registration, made at least one day ahead.

stops.name: Bach Ma National Park
stops.note: Confirm the km 12 rule at the gate, because motor vehicles stop there from 1 January 2026 and a June 2026 account sends you about 600 m around the slip before a motorbike or more walking.

approach.note: Start at the visitor center before 09:00 and be back before 17:00, confirm the clock against a second table that lists 07:30–17:00, and walk the summit road of about 16 km.

stops.name: Do Quyen Waterfall
stops.note: From km 16 the path is about 1.5 km and about 30 minutes, and this is the one trail to add.

approach.note: Leave km 16 on the summit road for the lip.

additions.name: Summit villas
additions.note: Stay the night only when the park has already accepted a registration made at least one day ahead.

seoTitle: Bach Ma in a day: the road, then one trail
seoDescription: A Bach Ma day starts before 09:00 and ends at the visitor center before 17:00. Confirm the km 12 rule, then add Đỗ Quyên.
